services.name: Personal Training & Rehab
services.title: Personal Training & Rehab in Robertson Quay, Singapore | ReGen Performance
services.metaDescription: Integrated one-to-one personal training in Robertson Quay, Singapore. Strength training, sports massage and osteopathic manual therapy in one session, for pain-free strength and performance. Free 30-minute discovery call.
services.h1: Personal Training & Rehab in Robertson Quay
services.lead: One-to-one sessions that combine strength training, sports massage and osteopathic manual therapy, adjusted to what your body needs each time. At Platinum Fitness, 22 Martin Road.
services.card: One-to-one coaching that blends exercise and hands-on therapy, adjusted to what your body needs each session.
whoFor: You want to get stronger, leaner or fitter, with a coach who plans every session around you
You train but keep running into the same aches, tightness or injuries
You are returning to exercise after an injury, surgery or a long break
You are new to the gym and want to learn to train safely and confidently
whatToExpect: A movement and posture assessment in your first session, so we understand why your body moves the way it does
A plan built around your goals, history and schedule
Sessions tailored on the day: strength training, sports massage, osteopathic manual therapy, or a mix of all three
Notes and exercise videos between sessions, so you keep progressing on your own
services.why: One session, everything your body needs. Most people would see a trainer, a massage therapist and a manual therapist separately. At ReGen it is one coach, one plan and one session rate, and every session follows the same system: find the root cause, organise how the body moves, then load it progressively.

faq.question: How much does personal training cost?
faq.answer: Rates depend on the coach and package, from about $120 to $180 per session, with lower per-session rates on 5 and 12 session packages. The same rate applies whether a session is training, hands-on therapy or a mix. Your 30-minute discovery call is free.

faq.question: Is sports massage or manual therapy charged separately?
faq.answer: No. It is all part of the same integrated session at your coach's usual rate. A session can be all training, all hands-on therapy, or half and half, depending on what your body needs that day.

faq.question: Do you work with injuries and pain?
faq.answer: Yes. Rehab and pain-free strength is our speciality. We assess how you move, work on the cause, and rebuild strength step by step. If something needs medical attention, we will tell you and refer you on.

faq.question: Where are you located?
faq.answer: Inside Platinum Fitness at Robertson Quay, 22 Martin Road, #04-01, Singapore 239058. A short walk from Great World, Fort Canning and Havelock MRT.

services.name: Sports Massage
services.title: Sports Massage in Robertson Quay, Singapore | ReGen Performance
services.metaDescription: Sports massage in Robertson Quay, Singapore. Book a full session of massage or combine it with training, at the same session rate. Certified therapists at Platinum Fitness, 22 Martin Road.
services.lead: Targeted sports massage to ease tight, aching muscles and recover faster. Book a full session of massage, or combine it with training. Same session, same rate.
services.card: Ease tight, aching muscles and recover faster, as a full session or combined with training.
whoFor: Tight neck, shoulders, back or hips from desk work or training
Runners, lifters and athletes who want to recover faster between sessions
Anyone preparing for, or recovering from, a race or competition
People who want hands-on work combined with exercise that keeps the results
whatToExpect: A short check of where you feel tight or sore and how you move
Hands-on sports massage on the areas that need it, using techniques such as deep tissue work, myofascial release and cupping where suitable
Use the whole session for massage, or split it with movement and strength work
Simple stretches or exercises to keep the improvement after the session
services.why: Our sports massage is part of the ReGen integrated session, delivered by certified therapists who are also strength and rehab coaches. The hands-on work fits how you actually train, so you leave looser and knowing what to do next.

faq.question: How is sports massage different from a regular massage?
faq.answer: Sports massage is targeted. We focus on the muscles and areas affecting your movement, recovery or performance, rather than general relaxation, and pair it with movement so the change lasts.

faq.question: Can I book just a sports massage?
faq.answer: Yes. A session can be fully sports massage, fully training, or a mix of both. It is priced the same as a regular ReGen session at your therapist's rate, and you decide together what your body needs that day.

faq.question: How do I book a sports massage?
faq.answer: Message us on WhatsApp at 9187 5632, or message one of the therapists below directly. Tell us where you feel tight or sore and we will arrange a time.

services.name: Osteopathic Manual Therapy
services.title: Osteopathic Manual Therapy in Robertson Quay, Singapore | ReGen Performance
services.metaDescription: Osteopathic manual therapy in Robertson Quay, Singapore, by coaches completing an MSc in Osteopathy (European School of Osteopathy, UK). Book a full session or combine it with training, at the same session rate.
services.eyebrow: Osteopathic Manual Therapy · Robertson Quay, Singapore
services.h1: Osteopathic Manual Therapy in Robertson Quay
services.lead: Hands-on osteopathic techniques to restore joint mobility and ease stiffness, combined with exercise so your body keeps the change. Book it as a full session or as part of your training.
services.card: Hands-on osteopathic techniques to restore joint mobility, as a full session or combined with training.
services.credentialNote: Delivered by coaches completing an MSc in Osteopathy at the European School of Osteopathy, UK, and certified in osteopathic and manual therapy techniques.
whoFor: Stiff, restricted joints in the neck, back, hips or shoulders
Recurring aches that stretching and massage alone have not fixed
Clients who want hands-on work as part of a training and rehab plan
People who prefer a whole-body approach to how they move and feel
whatToExpect: An assessment of posture, joint movement and how your body compensates
Hands-on techniques such as joint articulation and mobilisation, soft tissue work and, where appropriate, manipulation
Movement and strength exercises to lock in the change
A clear plan, and a referral to a doctor or other specialist if anything needs medical attention
services.why: Osteopathy looks at the body as one connected system, the same idea behind the ReGen Method. Pairing osteopathic manual therapy with coached exercise means you do not just feel better after the session; you build the strength and control to stay that way.

faq.question: Who delivers the osteopathic manual therapy?
faq.answer: Coaches who are completing an MSc in Osteopathy at the European School of Osteopathy in the UK, and who are certified in osteopathic and manual therapy techniques. We are always clear about what we do, and we refer you on when something needs medical care.

faq.question: What can osteopathic manual therapy help with?
faq.answer: Clients most often come to us for neck and shoulder stiffness, lower back tightness, hip and knee discomfort, and restricted movement from desk work or training. We assess first and tell you honestly whether we are the right fit.

faq.question: Is it separate from personal training?
faq.answer: It is part of the same integrated session. A session can be fully hands-on therapy, fully training, or half and half, at your coach's usual session rate.

faq.question: How do I book?
faq.answer: Message us on WhatsApp at 9187 5632, or contact one of the coaches below directly to book an assessment.
